title: Densities for scalar-valued BSDEs via unique continuation and backward uniqueness
abstract: arXiv:2610.02106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We give sufficient conditions ensuring that, at every fixed positive time, the scalar backward component of a Markovian forward-backward stochastic differential equation with multidimensional forward process admits a density with respect to Lebesgue measure. Existing density criteria for BSDEs often obtain Malliavin non-degeneracy through sign or monotonicity assumptions. We develop a different route for a scalar backward component with an arbitrary-dimensional forward state. Under regularity assumptions and a structural compatibility condition on the generator, the terminal condition is only required to be non-constant. The key idea is to deduce Malliavin non-degeneracy from deterministic rigidity of the critical set of the decoupling field. We combine Malliavin calculus with unique continuation and backward uniqueness for the associated semilinear parabolic equation. Unique continuation precludes the spatial gradient of the decouplin

translated_title: 基于唯一延拓与反向唯一性的标量值BSDE的密度
translated_abstract: 我们给出了充分条件，确保在每一个固定的正时刻，具有多维前向过程的马尔可夫正倒向随机微分方程的标量倒向分量关于勒贝格测度具有密度。现有的BSDE密度判据通常通过符号或单调性假设来获得Malliavin非退化性。我们针对具有任意维前向状态的标量倒向分量开辟了一条不同的路径。在正则性假设以及生成元上的结构相容性条件下，终端条件仅需非常值即可。核心思想是从解耦场临界集的确定性刚性出发推导出Malliavin非退化性。我们将Malliavin随机分析与相关半线性抛物型方程的唯一延拓性和反向唯一性相结合。唯一延拓性排除了（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文将Malliavin随机分析与半线性抛物型方程的唯一延拓性和反向唯一性相结合，从解耦场临界集的确定性刚性推导出Malliavin非退化性，从而在终端条件仅为非常值的弱假设下证明了多维前向过程对应的标量倒向分量具有密度。
en_tdlr: This paper combines Malliavin calculus with unique continuation and backward uniqueness of the associated semilinear parabolic equation to derive Malliavin non-degeneracy from the deterministic rigidity of the decoupling field's critical set, proving that the scalar backward component admits a density under the weak assumption of a merely non-constant terminal condition.
